what: The declared FLOOR for Bun FRONT overlays. Human pin. Same posture as runtimes/rails-base/FLOOR.json. This is NOT a rails-base FLOOR bump.
why: ADR 0071: FRONT is a Bun container with its own image. Overlays FROM that digest.
A mutable :latest is not a pin.
Do not auto-bump rails-base FLOOR.json when this file moves.

floor.note: LOCAL working floor, not a GHCR index. Built 2026-09-14 from runtimes/front-base on linux/arm64 (image id = repo digest sha256:43457ed9). Overlay Dockerfile.thin pins this. Do not treat this as a rails-base FLOOR move.

bun_base.note: Multi-arch index digest for the Bun runtime the FRONT Dockerfile FROMs. Not the front-base FLOOR.

moving_the_floor: Edit this file. That is the whole mechanism.
Every consumer's FRONT gate compares its pin to this file.
Never edit runtimes/rails-base/FLOOR.json as a side effect of a FRONT change.
